title: Project Starlight and the 2001 National Press Club event
summary: Steven Greer tells of Project Starlight and the 2001 National Press Club event, about mid-1990s-2001 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It was called Project Starlight code name. We were private and then it went public in 01 with the National Press Club that had 800 million people see it.

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for UFO disclosure, says he ran a private effort in the 1990s with the code name Project Starlight. He says it went public in 2001 at the National Press Club, a venue in Washington, DC for news events, and that 800 million people saw it, which he presents as a major moment in getting the truth about UFOs out.
